description: Transport plaintext fragmentation (SPEC.md §6.1). `message` split with fragment id 7 gives `fragments`; feeding them in order to a receiver gives back `message`. `scenarios` replay step by step against a fresh receiver: `output` is the complete JSON the step yields, or null.

boundaries.note: exactly the chunk size: sent whole
one byte over: two fragments, the second holding one byte

scenarios.name: a complete JSON message passes through
a repeated chunk drops the message
i not below n is dropped
a fragment with no chunk is ignored
an unknown first byte is ignored
a fifth partial message is dropped
an id can be reused once its message completed
